<!-- pr-reviewer: 37fc6ab0103c2c3065809396ebc72ef8735a9dda -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The glyph change is right, but the PR head fails two UI snapshot tests and its snapshot PNGs conflict with current main.

**What looks good**
- `icon_of` now takes `&State`; the section doors and machine door map to existing `Icon` variants, with no new asset (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs`, the `Cmd::More` / `Cmd::Machine` arms).
- The `Section` match is exhaustive, and the View door stays text-only as the PR says.
- Pinning tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ribbon_icon_tests.rs` cover every ribbon cell for Mill, Lathe and Mill-turn, and check that the machine door differs per workspace.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the changed non-test code. Clippy is clean.

**Local results** (reviewed the head as-is; the trial merge with `origin/main` 010bca6 conflicts on `RECOMMENDED.md` and on `egui_app.png` / `egui_app_light.png`, so it was not merged)
```
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib        : 238 passed, 2 failed, 2 ignored
  egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot_light  Image did not match snapshot. Diff: 1  (egui_app_light)
  egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot       Image did not match snapshot. Diff: 4  (egui_tool_editor)
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app    : 3 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test feedback    : 6 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell       : 19 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test machine     : 6 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test operations  : 31 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test models      : 4 passed
cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings : clean
```
Run with CWD `crates/ui`. The lib snapshot failures are pixel diffs, not missing goldens. The same two tests pass on a tree with current main (checked via the #227 trial merge), so the PNG baselines in this PR are what is out of date.

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch and regenerate the snapshot PNGs on that tree, so `egui_app_light.png` and `egui_tool_editor.png` match again (`crates/ui/tests/snapshots/`, `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`). Also resolve the `egui_app.png` conflict with main.
2. Resolve the `RECOMMENDED.md` conflict by keeping both entries.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The snapshot PNGs overlap with #232. Whichever merges second regenerates them again.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bbc36e160771245666d98a19617fb724207ab03c -->
**Not built: the head conflicts with current `origin/main` (88c131c).** Nothing was built or tested; please refresh the branch with `git merge origin/main` and push, and it will be reviewed again.

Conflicting files:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` (around line 103): this PR adds `#[cfg(test)] mod ribbon_icon_tests;` and main added `#[cfg(test)] mod fresh_op_tests;` in the same spot. Keep both module lines, each with its own `#[cfg(test)]`.
2. `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png`, `egui_app_light.png`, `egui_tool_editor.png`: binary conflicts, since the PR's new section-door glyphs and main's newer shell changes both alter these shell snapshots. Do not pick either side; after merging main, regenerate them from `crates/ui` with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, then check that `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` passes. Pixel diffs from another OS are a platform artifact, so regenerating on whatever platform you use is fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 19c8ab04a7856c8e3018b3b880a03b304920639d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `icon_of` now takes `&State`; section doors and the machine door map to existing `Icon` variants (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs`, the `Cmd::More` / `Cmd::Machine` arms). No new asset, so no new licence text is needed. The View door stays caption-only, as the PR says.
- The three shell snapshots differ from main's goldens only by the new glyphs on the Milling / Milling 2D / Milling 3D / Drilling / Multi-axis doors. I compared the PNGs side by side and found nothing else changed.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the non-test changes. The pinning tests are in `ribbon_icon_tests.rs`, and both `ribbon_icon_tests` and `fresh_op_tests` are wired in `mod.rs`.
- Process: body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #207`. The decision is in `docs/decisions/207-section-door-icons.md`. The PR touches no `.github`, build.rs, scripts or dependencies.

**Local results** (trial merge with current origin/main; merged cleanly)
```
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib (CWD crates/ui) : 277 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored
  ribbon_icon_tests (2)                          : ok
  egui shell + tool_editor snapshots             : ok
cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings : clean
```

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR files list includes `status_alert.rs` and `docs/decisions/192-status-alert.md`. These come from the merged #232 head, so they will drop out of the diff once #232 lands.
- `panes.rs` is about 1970 lines, far over the ~400-line guideline. The PR adds about 25 lines to it; flagging the growth only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
